Visit note | 2025-11-08 11:30 AM | Dr. Tahmina Begum, Dermatology | Patient: Pradip Kundu, 22, male. Mr. Kundu attends for a review regarding his skin. He reports spots on his back, blackheads and pimples on his face, and lingering marks left after pimples. These symptoms flared after using a heavy face cream bought in Jatrabari. He works as a graphic designer and has a known comorbidity of Hypothyroidism, for which he takes his regular thyroxine. On examination, there are about 25 inflamed spots on the face. Vitals: BP 120/71 mmHg, pulse 70 bpm, weight 62 kg. His skin is otherwise clear without severe scarring. Assessment: Acne vulgaris. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to wash the face twice daily with a gentle cleanser and do not squeeze spots. Follow-up in 2 months.

Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to avoid dust, wear a mask when cleaning, and wash bedding weekly. Follow-up in 1 month.
